description: Create a change request for a store (duplicates the live theme into an unpublished staging theme) and pull the theme into a local workspace directory. Returns the absolute workspace path to edit files in.

directory.description: Where to create the workspace; defaults to ./shopify-changes/<slug> under the current directory

request.description: What the merchant asked for, verbatim if possible

store.description: Store domain or id from shopbuddy_list_stores

title.description: Short title, e.g. 'Sticky add to cart on mobile'

name: shopbuddy_start_change
